subject.title: fix(sync): drain media before one-shot exit

question: Should this draft PR require live linked-device one-shot media proof before being marked merge-ready, despite focused regression, race, full-gate, and green CI evidence?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and well covered by fake WhatsApp tests, but the PR author explicitly left it draft because real WhatsApp validation did not complete.

options.title: Require live validation
options.body: Re-pair the linked device, rerun a real sync --once --download-media path, post redacted output or logs, then undraft and merge-review the narrow fix.

options.title: Accept current proof
options.body: Treat the focused regression test, race run, full-gate claim, and green CI as sufficient for this collaborator-authored bug fix without additional live proof.

options.title: Fold back into the broader PR
options.body: Pause this narrow PR and let https://github.com/openclaw/wacli/pull/291 carry the drain behavior with its broader media-completeness review.

recommendation.title: Require live validation
recommendation.body: Re-pair the linked device, rerun a real sync --once --download-media path, post redacted output or logs, then undraft and merge-review the narrow fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author also has the strongest current-main ownership signal for the sync/media lifecycle paths being changed.
